title: Chief Operating Officer (COO)
description:
InPlanet is a mission-driven, remote-first ClimateTech startup with hubs in Sao Paulo, Rio de Janeiro, New York, and London. We are scaling Enhanced Rock Weathering (ERW) in tropical agriculture to remove carbon, regenerate soils, and transform food production in the tropics.
Our vision is to sequester gigatons of CO2 while regenerating tropical soils, creating a livable planet with nutritious food and healthy ecosystems for future generations. We collaborate with farmers, scientists, and industry leaders and are experiencing rapid growth.
Our culture emphasizes people-first care and performance excellence . The Rocket symbolizes our ambition; the Heart reflects our empathy, integrity, and collective impact.
We pride ourselves on a diverse, inclusive team, primarily based in Brazil, where the climate impact is most significant. You can read reviews on Glassdoor about our interview process.

Check out our Culture page here.

About the Role

Location: Brazil (São Paulo or surrounding regions preferred)
Language Skills: Portuguese, English (fluent)
Start Date: Ideally Q3/4 2025

We seek a seasoned, strategic, and hands-on COO to lead our go-to-market strategy for mineral-based carbon removal products across agriculture and mining sectors . You will oversee our entire value chain, from mineral inputs and field operations to our science engine and technology roadmap. This senior role combines bold strategy with operational precision to scale our impact.
Your role involves refining product-market fit , identifying scalable customer use cases , and leading the integration of deployment, scientific standards, and operational scaling. You will collaborate closely with our Chief Impact Officer and Head of Operations on regional management and logistics, and with our VP of Science to align field strategy with scientific standards and climate goals. You will ensure our product offers agronomic value and meets carbon certification standards, scaling pilots into high-impact operations at a national level.
The ideal candidate has a strong operational track record , preferably in Brazilian agribusiness , capable of bridging execution with innovation .
You will report directly to the CEO and be a key member of the Senior Leadership Team , leading a growing team including:

  • Head of Operations and project deployment teams
  • Strategic partners including the Chief Impact Officer and commercial teams
  • Close collaboration with the VP of Science
  • Coordination with Carbon and Technology teams
About InPlanet

InPlanet is a ClimateTech startup with hubs across Germany, Brazil, and the US, focusing on scaling ERW in tropical agriculture. Our vision is to sequester gigatons of CO2 while regenerating soils. We value a culture of care and excellence, with a diverse, inclusive team primarily active in Brazil. Check our Glassdoor reviews and Culture page for more insights.

About the Role

Location: Brazil (São Paulo preferred)
Language Skills: Portuguese, English
Start Date: Q3/4 2025

We seek a strategic COO to lead go-to-market efforts and operational scaling. Responsibilities include overseeing the entire value chain, ensuring product-market fit, and scaling deployment from pilots to national impact. You will work closely with senior leaders and lead a team to ensure operational excellence and scientific integrity, fostering trust with farming partners and scaling our impact.

Key ResponsibilitiesStrategy, Innovation & Scaling Operations
  • Define and scale our carbon removal product from early traction to market leader.
  • Design and execute scalable ERW deployment operations in Brazil.
  • Translate climate goals into operational strategies.
  • Improve operations through KPIs and data-driven performance.
Agricultural & Supply Chain Leadership
  • Drive go-to-market strategies, building trust with stakeholders.
  • Develop partnerships with suppliers, logistics, and regional stakeholders.
  • Oversee sourcing, logistics, and deployment of rock powder.
  • Ensure compliance with standards and regulations.
Science-Driven Operations & Technology Alignment
  • Collaborate with science and tech teams to integrate R&D and data flows.
  • Ensure product efficacy and credibility in real-world deployment.
  • Support legal efforts for carbon reporting and impact.
Team & Culture Building
  • Build an entrepreneurial, accountable leadership culture.
  • Mentor and grow operations teams in Brazil and globally.
  • Promote a culture of collaboration and impact.
  • Empower regional managers and technical leads.
Ideal Candidate Profile

Core Skills & Experience

  • 10+ years in senior operations, supply chain, or agribusiness, especially in Brazil or high-growth/startup contexts.
  • Experience scaling from early-stage to market success, ideally as a founder, GM, or CEO.
  • Proven leadership of multidisciplinary teams and scalable systems.
  • Fluent in Portuguese and English.

Key Qualities

  • Visionary yet pragmatic, balancing strategy and urgency.
  • Confident, emotionally intelligent leadership.
  • Comfort with complexity, ambiguity, and rapid growth.
  • Hands-on, humble, willing to get involved physically when needed.
  • Passion for sustainability and climate innovation.

Bonus Points

  • Experience in impact sectors like climate or regenerative agriculture.
  • Deep network in Brazilian agriculture, logistics, or mining.
  • Experience building strategic partnerships in Brazil.
  • Experience developing and scaling agricultural tech.
Our Values
  • Trust: Promote transparency and kindness.
  • Drive: Take action with urgency and purpose.
  • Impact: Aim to make a meaningful global difference.
Benefits
  • Competitive salary and transparent expectations.
  • Share options to foster ownership.
  • Home office budget, hybrid remote work (around São Paulo).
  • Personal development and language allowances.
  • 40 days of annual leave.
  • Autonomy to innovate and impact.
  • Bi-annual team offsites in Brazil.
  • Equipment such as laptops.
Compensation Philosophy

We ensure fair, equitable pay across regions, considering location, skills, and market conditions, with transparent ranges and adjustments to maintain competitiveness and fairness.

Application Process

Approximately 8 hours over 4-6 weeks, including multiple interviews, references, and profiling. Follow us on LinkedIn and subscribe to our newsletter for updates.

How to Apply
  • Submit your CV in English unless justified otherwise.

Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation, and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office-based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.

The company is founder-led, profitable, and growing.

Help us shape the future of open source IT, devops, and IS, from bare metal to containers. Our goal is to revolutionise open source application and infrastructure operations.

We want to transform the world of software operations by enabling true model-driven operations via next-generation infrastructure-as-code. This will allow companies to run very efficient bare-metal operations for high-performance computing, private cloud, data lakes, AI/ML, and analytics. We need to invent some new technology, and we need to build some new products; we are therefore looking for someone who can lead and inspire a regional software engineering team to fulfill this initiative.

The Solutions Engineering team works in close collaboration with our managed infrastructure operations team, which runs many private OpenStack clouds and Kubernetes clusters for customers around the world. This enables us to improve our infra-as-code products based on our own real experience, mirroring that of our users and customers. We work in Python, creating open source automation capabilities that simplify operations for anybody, anywhere, who is building on Ubuntu.

Most of the team's work involves pure Python software development focused on enabling true DevOps workflows. We strive for high quality in both design, documentation, tests, and performance as we enhance operations code packages and Ubuntu itself in order to ensure our platform is the easiest, most robust, and best performing for driving your infrastructure.

This role is ideal for software engineers who want to work in a global team, have a passion for distributed systems and cloud computing, and an interest in the entire Linux stack - from kernel to networking to virtualization and containers.

What you will do

  • Work in Python and Golang to design and deliver open source software operations code
  • Work with the entire Linux stack, from kernel, networking, storage, to applications
  • Shape high quality open source monitoring and alerting infrastructure
  • Rethink open source operations for our customers and open source community
  • Demonstrate sound engineering design and testing principles in your code
  • Follow agile software development practices
  • Coach and develop your colleagues where you have insights
  • Grow a healthy, collaborative engineering culture in line with the company values
  • Global travel up to 10% of time for internal and external events

Who you are

  • You are a passionate Python developer
  • You are organised and want your team to deliver timely, high quality software
  • You understand the importance of reliable operations in an agile world
  • You have sound knowledge of cloud computing concepts & technologies
  • You have practical knowledge of Linux and networking
  • You are a lifelong learner

Bonus points for

  • You have graduated with a university degree in Computer Science or related software engineering field
  • Golang programming skills

What we offer colleagues

We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognize outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus or commission. We provide all team members with additional benefits which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.

  • Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person
  • Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year
  • Annual compensation review
  • Recognition rewards
  • Annual holiday leave
  • Maternity and paternity leave
  • Team Member Assistance Program & Wellness Platform
  • Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues
  • Priority Pass and travel upgrades for long-haul company events

About Canonical

Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open-source projects and the platform for AI, IoT, and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence; in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since our inception in 2004. Working here is a step into the future and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.

Canonical is an equal opportunity employer

We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

Quem é Stone Tech?

A Stone nasceu com o propósito de ser protagonista na transformação da indústria de pagamentos, lutando para oferecer as melhores soluções para quem empreende no Brasil.

Quem é Stone Tech?

A Stone nasceu com o propósito de ser protagonista na transformação da indústria de pagamentos, lutando para oferecer as melhores soluções para quem empreende no Brasil.

Pensando nisso, construímos a Stone Tech! A junção dos times de tecnologia Stone Co. e as empresas financeiras do grupo que reconhecem o potencial empreendedor de cada brasileiro. Por aqui, temos todas as inovações e tecnologias de ponta da Stone, Pagar.me, Ton e Vitta, com uma galera referência no mercado de tecnologia, em um ambiente descontraído, repleto de desafios, oportunidades, flexibilidade, teamplay e desenvolvimento contínuo.

Nossa Cultura

Por aqui, vivemos nossa cultura no dia a dia, guiados por esses 5 pilares:

Own It: Ter espírito de dono te faz conquistar a liberdade. Valorizamos a autonomia e a proatividade, somos responsáveis pelo o que entregamos e queremos sempre evoluir o nosso negócio.

Live the Ride: Faça. Feito é melhor que perfeito. Aprendemos com os erros e encaramos desafios como oportunidades de aprendizado.

No Bullshit: Agir com simplicidade. Somos pessoas práticas, sinceras e gostamos de feedbacks. Sabemos que às vezes vamos errar e contamos com essa transparência para evoluirmos.

Team Play: Se quer ir rápido, vá sozinho(a). Se quer ir longe, trabalhe em equipe. É sempre possível aprender com as outras pessoas e a colaboração é a chave do sucesso.

The Reason: O cliente não tem razão, ele é a razão. Nos motivamos a enxergar o impacto do nosso trabalho na vida do cliente, é vendo que melhoramos a vida dele que sabemos que fizemos uma boa entrega.

Como é Ser Uma Pessoa Software Engineer Go Senior

Procuramos uma pessoa desenvolvedora apaixonada por desafios, tecnologia e conhecimento. Essa pessoa, junto ao time, será responsável por:

  • Atuar no desenvolvimento e manutenção de novas funcionalidades;
  • Ter responsabilidade para desenvolver em sistemas de importância crítica para a companhia;
  • Monitorar o desempenho e a aplicação das alterações dos sistemas;
  • Documentar as mudanças realizadas;

Join to apply for the Partner Sales Director - IHV Alliances role at Canonical

Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation, and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office-based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.

The company is founder-led, profitable, and growing.

We are seeking a highly motivated and experienced IHV Alliance Sales Director to join our strategic partnerships team who will be responsible for leading IHV Alliances in the EMEA or APAC regions. Reporting to the Head of IHV Alliances, the IHV Alliance Sales Director will work closely with IHV and Canonical teams in those geographies to develop and maintain strong relationships with senior executives at strategic partner organizations, fostering collaboration and alignment on joint business objectives. The IHV Alliance Sales Director will manage and grow a team of Business Development Managers and help them identify and pursue new business opportunities with IHVs, driving revenue growth and market expansion, develop and execute go-to-market strategies for joint offerings, oversee the day-to-day management of alliances including contract negotiations and performance tracking, and issue resolution.

The Director is responsible for building trusted relationships with IHV partners, increasing Canonical market share and attach rate, evangelising the partnership and leading all business interactions from engineer to CxO. They will often run customer workshops focused on particular initiatives at that customer, attend sales events, give public presentations and lead executive engagements.

Location: This role will be based remotely in EMEA or APAC regions.

As an IHV Alliance Sales Director you will:

  • Build strategic relationships with IHV partners at all levels
  • Grow their awareness of open source capabilities on Canonical Ubuntu
  • Demonstrate a deep understanding of the Linux and cloud software ecosystem
  • Negotiate contracts and commercial business terms
  • Demonstrate a deep understanding of large and complex organizations
  • Lead partnerships in APAC with companies like Lenovo, Huawei, Quanta, Fujitsu, Inspur, H3C, NEC, Asus etc.
  • Lead partnerships in EMEA with companies like Ericsson, Nokia, Bull, Siemens
  • Lead partnerships in the Americas with companies like Dell, HPE, IBM, Supermicro
  • Work closely with marketing, sales engineering and product management
  • Deliver on targets, objectives and provide a voice of the partner
  • Lead executive interlocks between IHV and Canonical leadership
  • Travel regularly - sometimes internationally - to drive partnerships in person

Valued skills and experience

  • Experience in alliance or indirect sales management roles
  • Autonomous, disciplined, hands-on, get-it-done mentality
  • Ability to capture customer requirements, evaluate gaps, identify and create opportunities
  • Passionate about Ubuntu products and mission
  • Comfortable in fast-paced and high pressure environments with measurable goals
  • Experience with Linux, virtualization, containers, and other cloud technologies.
  • Excellent communication and presentation skills

What we offer colleagues

We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognize outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus or commission. We provide all team members with additional benefits which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.

  • Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person
  • Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year
  • Annual compensation review
  • Recognition rewards
  • Annual holiday leave
  • Maternity and paternity leave
  • Team Member Assistance Program & Wellness Platform
  • Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues
  • Priority Pass and travel upgrades for long-haul company events

About Canonical

Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open-source projects and the platform for AI, IoT, and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence; in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since our inception in 2004. Working here is a step into the future and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.

Canonical is an equal opportunity employer

We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

The Senior Service Delivery Manager is responsible for all aspects of Service Delivery Management for Corporate and Tournament technology support operations for the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027 TM (FWWC 2027) within Brazil. The role entails working in close collaboration with the Technology teams in Brazil and Zurich, and other key stakeholders.

  • Lead on the definition of the Asset tracking and management of deployed equipment in all sites.

  • Contribute to the Technology readiness program, including test events and exercises, policies and procedures and training of the team.
  • Be a key member of the Technology team and work collaboratively with colleagues across the organisation and FIFA Technology team as defined by the operational organisational structure.
  • Lead, build and manage a strong diverse team composed of paid staff, contractors, and volunteers for operating the technology services in scope.

Your profile

  • University degree or similar higher education, in Information Technology, Computer Science or related field.
  • A minimum of 8 years overall IT experience and minimum 4 years of experience in a similar role.
  • Experience in the Sports / major event industry.
  • Proven track record of successful delivery of complex IT programs and project.
  • Strong IT skills and relevant knowledge in Service Delivery Management.
  • Good Procurement and contract management skills.
  • Highly adept at consulting, negotiating, communicating, consensus building and facilitation.
  • Good analytical skills and problem‑solving skills.
  • Excellent people management, verbal and written communication, training, and presentation skills.
  • Team Player, willing to work with tight timelines.
  • Positive attitude, patience and persistence.
  • ITIL foundations.
  • Right to work in Brazil.
  • Fluent in English (spoken and written).
  • Fluent in Portuguese (spoken and written).
  • Proficiency in any other FIFA language (FR / ES / GER) is an asset.
  • Willing to travel within Brazil (up to 20%).
  • Ability to re‑locate to Rio de Janeiro.
About FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027

The FIFA Women’s World Cup™ is the greatest women’s sporting event on the planet, showcasing the best players in the world on the biggest stage. In 2027, history will be made as Brazil welcomes the tournament to South America for the first time ever.

This landmark event will unite the world through an unprecedented celebration of women’s football, inspiring billions of fans across the globe. As we prepare to host teams and supporters from every corner of the world, we’re looking for passionate, talented individuals to be part of history and help deliver an unforgettable tournament.

Join us and play your role in making FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ a truly extraordinary experience that celebrates and elevates women’s football.

title: Especialista de Dados em Saúde
description:
Job description

Jeito DaVita

O Jeito de Ser DaVita significa que nós dedicamos nossas Mentes, Corações e Mãos para atingir a Missão, vivenciar os Valores e construir uma Aldeia saudável. Cuidamos uns dos outros com a mesma intensidade com que cuidamos dos nossos pacientes.

Gostou? Junte-se a nós e faça a diferença na sua vida e na de nossos pacientes! Vamos juntos construir a melhor comunidade de saúde que o mundo já viu!

Main responsibilities

Responsabilidades

  • Consolidar e validar dados clínicos e operacionais das unidades de diálise, garantindo a integridade, confiabilidade e comparabilidade dos indicadores entre as clínicas.
  • Desenvolver dashboards interativos e relatórios executivos que monitorem indicadores assistenciais e de performance médica, fornecendo visibilidade clara para o CMO e atendendo também às necessidades de reporte internacional.
  • Criar e manter processos ETL (extração, transformação e carregamento de dados) de forma eficiente e auditável, assegurando que os fluxos de dados sejam robustos e padronizados.
  • Desenvolver modelos de machine learning e análises estatísticas avançadas para previsão de riscos clínicos, como probabilidades de mortalidade, internações, inadimplência ao tratamento ou outras intercorrências relevantes.
  • Trabalhar com grandes volumes de dados estruturados e não estruturados, incluindo dados de prontuários clínicos, resultados laboratoriais e informações operacionais, sempre com foco em gerar insights acionáveis que apoiem decisões médicas.
  • Atuar de forma colaborativa com equipes multidisciplinares da Diretoria Médica (qualidade, enfermagem, educação médica, etc.) e também com times internacionais, alinhando necessidades e compartilhando melhores práticas em análises de dados em saúde.
  • Realizar pesquisa e exploração de literatura científica pertinente (papers, guidelines, estudos clínicos) para embasar análises e sustentar recomendações com evidências atualizadas do setor de nefrologia e saúde populacional.
  • Garantir governança e conformidade dos dados utilizados, respeitando políticas de privacidade (LGPD), segurança da informação e os padrões globais da companhia para manipulação e reporte de dados clínicos.
Requirements and skills
  • Formação superior completa.
  • Experiência sólida em análise e modelagem de dados clínicos, incluindo entendimento profundo de indicadores de saúde e métricas assistenciais (preferencialmente em contextos de nefrologia, diálise ou atenção especializada).
  • Conhecimento avançado em R, Python, SQL e Power BI, com capacidade de manipular grandes bases de dados e desenvolver visualizações interativas de alto impacto.
  • Domínio de estatística descritiva e inferencial, com habilidade para construir e implementar modelos preditivos (por exemplo, regressão, árvores de decisão, random forests, etc.) aplicados a problemas reais de saúde.
  • Experiência prática com dashboards interativos e automação de processos analíticos – seja desenvolvendo soluções em R Shiny, Power BI (Power Query, DAX) ou outras ferramentas que permitam agilizar a entrega de insights.
  • Atuação prévia em ambientes de saúde (operadoras, hospitais, clínicas ou empresas de saúde digital), com familiaridade nos fluxos de dados assistenciais; experiência em nefrologia ou cuidados renais será um diferencial significativo.
  • Inglês avançado, especialmente para leitura de artigos técnicos/científicos e para elaboração de relatórios ou apresentações ao time internacional (é esperado que este profissional interaja com materiais e stakeholders em inglês).

Serão considerados diferenciais:

  • Formação acadêmica adicional: Mestrado ou pós-graduação em Epidemiologia, Bioestatística, Saúde Pública ou áreas afins, demonstrando aprofundamento teórico em métodos de pesquisa em saúde.
  • Experiência em transformação digital na saúde: Participação em projetos de transformação digital ou inovação em saúde (por exemplo, implementação de prontuário eletrônico, inteligência artificial em saúde, telemedicina), evidenciando capacidade de navegar em iniciativas de mudança tecnológica.
  • Produção científica: Histórico de participação em publicações científicas, estudos clínicos ou projetos de pesquisa baseados em dados, indicando habilidade de gerar conhecimento novo e seguir boas práticas de ciência de dados (documentação, reprodutibilidade, etc.).
Additional information

O que oferecemos?

  • Plano de Saúde: para cuidar do seu bem-estar e da sua família. "Porque saúde é o que interessa." ⚕️
  • Plano Odontológico: para que o seu sorriso fique sempre impecável e bonito.
  • Vale Transporte: para facilitar o seu deslocamento.
  • Vale Alimentação e Vale Refeição: porque fazer compras vale mais que mil palavras.

Local de trabalho: Barra da Tijuca ( Modelo híbrido 1x na semana em Home Office)

Horário de trabalho: 09:00 às 18:00

title: Funcionários da Faetec passam a receber vale-alimentação
description:
Funcionários da Faetec passam a receber vale-alimentação

A Fundação de Apoio à Escola Técnica (Faetec), vinculada à Secretaria de Estado de Ciência, Tecnologia e Inovação, iniciou nesta quinta-feira (26) a distribuição do vale-alimentação a todos os funcionários da Rede. A partir de agora, servidores de carreira e de contratos temporários podem contar com um cartão com valor mensal que pode chegar a R$660,00.

Os funcionários com carga horária de 20h semanais irão receber o valor mensal de R$330,00. Para os profissionais que trabalham 40h e 60h será depositado a quantia de R$660,00. O cartão poderá ser utilizado em estabelecimentos parceiros e já está sendo distribuído a todos os 5.162 funcionários, que atuam em mais de 120 unidades da Rede, em 63 municípios do Estado.

Além da Presidente da Faetec, Caroline Alves, o Secretário de Ciência, Tecnologia e Inovação, Mauro Azevedo Neto, esteve presente na entrega do primeiro vale-alimentação a um servidor da Rede. Ele acredita que o benefício chega para reconhecer os esforços do servidor.

“Sempre que tínhamos reuniões, a Carol trazia essa pauta como valorização do servidor, então é um prazer estar aqui no momento dessa entrega. Sou filho de professora da rede estadual de educação e sei como os auxílios aos servidores e a valorização do servidor são importantes. Na secretaria já fui assistente, assessor, chefe de gabinete, subsecretário e hoje estou como secretário, então sei que são os servidores que constroem a secretaria e a Faetec. O governador está sendo um parceiro nas pautas de educação, a gente sabe que o orçamento é curto, mas sempre que valoriza o servidor, ele é bem gasto”, declarou o S ecretário.

Os servidores e temporários recebem o vale-alimentação com o benefício referente aos meses de setembro e outubro. A medida não só reconhece e valoriza os profissionais que atuam nas unidades da Faetec, mas contribui para um ambiente de trabalho mais saudável e motivador.

Para Caroline Alves, presidente da Faetec, a entrega do vale-alimentação só foi possível graças ao empenho dos próprios funcionários, que se dedicam diariamente para que a Faetec continue sendo uma instituição de excelência. A gestora aproveitou a ocasião para agradecer a parceria da Secretaria.

“Essa é uma causa dos servidores de muitos anos e é uma construção que estamos fazendo juntos, sempre tenho esse cuidado de ouvir o outro, dialogar e construir isso junto. Eu acredito que essa entrega é importante para a nossa Rede e não posso deixar de mencionar o secretário que nos ajudou, abriu caminhos e deu suporte nessa construção”, concluiu a presidente da Faetec.

Company Description

Welcome to the good side of tech

You might have heard about us but with a different name: Feegow, Doctoralia or Docplanner. The names are different depending on the country we are located in, but we are all part of Docplanner Group.

It all started over 12 years ago when we asked ourselves: is anyone in healthcare thinking about patients? We jumped in and we empowered patients by giving them access to leave and read reviews about their visit. We then provided doctors with the technology to manage bookings easily and save time, so they could devote themselves to what they always wanted: treating patients. And today is the day in which we ask you: wanna join us in the next step helping people live longer and healthier lives?

Where does Feegow fit here?

In 2022 Feegow joined the Docplanner Group, a health-tech company. We are dedicated to developing innovative solutions and promoting access to top-tier management for physicians seeking to take their practices to the next level, as well as managers in search of a robust solution that covers end-to-end operations. Our ultimate goal is to create a world where everyone can access high-quality healthcare.

Docplanner Group at scale

We are leaders in 13 countries so far, and more than 50 million patients trust us every month. 300.000+ specialists believe in us and our product, and so do leading venture capital funds such as Point Nine Capital, Goldman Sachs Asset Management and One Peak Partners. And yet, employing over 2.500 people all over the globe, we managed to keep the startup-mindset we started with over 12 years ago.

And why should you join us?

Because it feels good to tell your family and your friends how you made the world a little bit better. You go to bed knowing that what you do matters, and that your talents align with your beliefs.

We want to make the healthcare experience more human, and that starts with you being you. We believe that considering the diversity of human experience makes a better healthcare experience for all. We’re not just different: we embrace diversity. We will encourage you to come to work your whole self, and that includes not coming to the office at all if you prefer not to, as we\'re 100% remote-friendly.

Remote model: you can work 100% from home, but you are also welcome in our offices in Curitiba and Rio de Janeiro.

Job Description

Feegow is the leading Practice Management System (PMS) in Brazil for individual doctors & large clinics alike, and a highly strategic product for Docplanner Group, as a foundation to conquer the Brazilian market.

We are looking for a passionate and experienced Director of Product for Feegow to lead our product teams, drive innovation, accountability, and play a key role in our product\'s modernization. This is a remote-friendly role within Brazil, where you’ll foster collaboration between global teams, steer product development, and manage a talented product team. Your expertise in building a data-driven & business minded product culture whilst delivering fast & safe iterations, knowing when to go for PoCs & robust solutions based on the business appetite and product maturity will ensure the continued growth of Feegow and Docplanner Group.

What we expect from this position:

  • Inspire, lead and bring in PMS product vision to all product managers and teams.
  • Understand a complex environment where the teams have not only individual doctors and clinics that should be delighted with their Efficiency platform, whilst bringing them new value propositions like Visibility & Growth, as well as betting on AI as a door opener for exponential value.
  • Define with PMs the product strategy on every team, how it relates to the broader Brazilian strategy & Docplanner Tech & Product strategy.
  • Influence and establish a shared vision with other business areas as Sales, Operations and Marketing. Be a key stakeholder for Individuals and Clinics Business owners.
  • Ensure upcoming product needs and opportunities aligned with your Engineering Director and Country Managers to create a coherent Product & Tech Strategy and Roadmap.
  • Champion a hands-on approach to innovation by using a combination of Data, listening to the market, and “getting out of the building” to get first-hand customer/user insights.
  • Create a culture of decision-making based on insight, analysis and data across the business.
  • Work closely with our Global VP Product, on standardizing the objectives in clear indicators & tasks and bring transparency on ‘the plan’ across the whole company.
Qualifications
  • Minimum 3 years’ work experience as Product Director / GPM (managing and coaching a group of Product Managers)
  • Experience on B2B SaaS scale-ups
  • Solid experience in fast high-growth environment, change management, & business growth
  • A proven track record of delivering significant success, scaling and developing high performing digital products that impact business & delight customers
  • Expertise in the end-to-end product development lifecycle, agile and lean software development practices
  • An entrepreneurial mindset with outstanding organizational, communicative and leadership skills
  • Business savvy, holistic business acumen outside of Product Management and ability to assess product market fit
  • Analytical abilities and problem-solving skills
  • Experience in healthcare is a plus not a must
  • Experience in modernizing tech debt whilst delivering product value is a plus
  • Hands-on: In Docplanner, being a people manager does not mean only managing people, but being able to dive in the details of problems, opportunities & solutions.
Additional Information

What will you get in return?

Let’s talk money

  • A salary adequate to your experience and skills between R$37,000and R$44.500. Your salary will be, now and always, 100% transparent to you;

Benefits:

  • 100% remote-friendly within Brazil
  • Working hours are from Monday to Friday, from 9 am to 6 pm;
  • We have compensatory time off (Banco de Horas);
  • Food/Market Voucher;
  • Medical, Dental, and Group Life Insurance;
  • Pet Plan;
  • iFeel app, for emotional comfort;
  • Gympass for you and up to 3 people!
  • Creditas: Payroll loan services, eligible after 6 months of employment;
  • Stock Options- eligible after 6 months of employment (5 years grace period)
  • Birthday Day Off;
  • Daycare Assistance;
  • Partnership Club, with discounts ranging from teaching institutions, such as colleges and language learning services;
  • Referral Program offers up to R$600 per person who stays with us for more than 6 months;
  • Leave of Absence/Time-off: in the event of the passing of loved ones, we offer 10 days off; if your pet passes away, we offer 2 days. Got married? 7 days of rest! Did the baby arrive? We offer 30 days for Dads and 6 months for Moms;

Job Overview

Cloud & Industrial Edge Architect – Siemens Energy

Join to apply for the role of Cloud & Industrial Edge Architect at Siemens Energy. You’ll help design and operate the hybrid (on‑prem + cloud) infrastructure that powers Siemens Energy’s industrial digitalisation solutions. With solid experience in Microsoft Azure and working knowledge of GCP and AWS, you’ll contribute to building secure, reliable, and scalable connections between industrial (OT) environments and cloud platforms, enabling data services, analytics, and smarter operations.

  • Support the design and implementation of hybrid architectures connecting edge/on‑prem systems with the cloud.
  • Deploy and maintain cloud and edge components for data ingestion, storage, and monitoring.
  • Enable secure OT–IT integrations (VPN, private links, authentication, certificates).
  • Develop Infrastructure‑as‑Code and CI/CD automation practice.
  • Monitor and tune performance, cost, and reliability of deployed environments.
  • Work closely with automation, data, and product teams to bring industrial data into digital platforms.
  • Participate in solution reviews, proposals, and technical discussions with internal and external partners.
Qualifications
  • 5+ years crafting, building, and operating cloud/hybrid infrastructure for production systems.

  • Exposure to GCP or AWS (some practical experience is welcome, not mandatory).
  • Strong hybrid integration skills: site‑to‑cloud connectivity, private networking, DNS, certificates, edge/IoT.
  • IaC & DevOps: Terraform (or Bicep/ARM), Git‑based workflows, pipelines (e.g., GitHub Actions/Azure DevOps), artifact registries.
  • Containers & Orchestration: Kubernetes/AKS (or similar), registry, ingress, telemetry, backup/DR patterns.
  • Awareness of data flows from OT systems (OPC UA, MQTT, or equivalent).
  • Security‑by‑design approach (identity, secrets management, policy‑as‑code, vulnerability management, compliance).
  • Effective collaborator communication with multi‑functional and international teams.
  • Degree in Engineering (any), Computer Science, or proven equivalent experience.
  • Proficient English; knowledge of other languages is an asset.

  • Familiarity with edge runtimes (Azure IoT Edge, Kubernetes at the edge), time‑series/observability stacks.

Our Transformation of Industry division is decarbonising the industrial sector. Growing electrification and efficiency are key and demand for green H2 and derivative fuels will rise. Our focus is on decarbonising manufacturing and adopting balanced approaches with industry clients, global networks, tech, and coordinated implementation.

Siemens Energy meets the growing energy demand across 90+ countries while ensuring our climate is protected. With more than ~100,000 dedicated employees, we generate electricity for over 16% of the global community and use our technology to help protect people and the environment.

Siemens Energy’s location in One Cotroceni Park, Bucharest, offers a vibrant community. The office is surrounded by green spaces, shopping, and is within walking distance of the Academia Militara subway station.

We celebrate diversity across 130 nationalities and do not discriminate based on ethnic background, gender, age, religion, identity, or disability.

Responsabilidades e atribuições
  • Realizar visitas técnicas para reconhecimento de riscos ocupacionais por meio de inspeções presenciais nos locais de trabalho das empresas clientes, observando processos, atividades e condições ambientais, a fim de identificar potenciais riscos, subsidiar a elaboração de programas, laudos e relatórios de segurança e indicar medidas preventivas necessárias.

  • Realizar análise de riscos ocupacionais nas empresas clientes avaliando informações coletadas em campo e comparando-as com a legislação e normas aplicáveis, a fim de classificar riscos, subsidiar a elaboração de documentos técnicos e orientar sobre medidas de controle que reduzam a exposição dos trabalhadores.
  • Receber e validar checklists das visitas técnicas realizadas por profissionais de campo, conferindo o correto preenchimento conforme padrões estabelecidos, a fim de garantir a confiabilidade dos registros para acompanhamento de conformidades e subsidiar a elaboração de programas, laudos e relatórios da área.
  • Elaborar documentos técnicos da área de SST redigindo laudos, pareceres, relatórios e programas com base em dados coletados, a fim de formalizar informações técnicas e atender requisitos legais e contratuais dos clientes.
  • Desenvolver e ministrar treinamentos de SST em formato online e presencial, por meio de preparação de materiais didáticos, aplicando metodologias participativas e utilizando recursos digitais, a fim de capacitar trabalhadores e gestores e promover a conscientização e o cumprimento das normas de segurança.
  • Inspecionar ambientes de trabalho observando atividades, condições físicas, máquinas e equipamentos, registrando não conformidades, a fim de propor ações corretivas e preventivas que promovam ambientes mais seguros e conformes.
  • Prestar orientações técnicas de SST aos clientes respondendo demandas por e-mail, reuniões ou visitas, fundamentadas em legislação e boas práticas, a fim de apoiar gestores e trabalhadores na tomada de decisão em relação à saúde e segurança.
  • Realizar reuniões técnicas com clientes participando de encontros presenciais ou virtuais para alinhamento de ações e esclarecimento de dúvidas, a fim de manter comunicação clara e transparente e garantir o alinhamento entre consultoria e cliente.

description:
Join to apply for the DevOps Engineer (Senior/Lead) ID43756 role at AgileEngine

AgileEngine is an Inc. 5000 company that creates award‑winning software for Fortune 500 brands and trailblazing startups across 17+ industries. We rank among the leaders in areas such as application development and AI/ML, and our people‑first culture has earned us multiple Best Place to Work awards.

WHY JOIN US

If you’re looking for a place to grow, make an impact, and work with people who care, we’d love to meet you!

ABOUT THE ROLE

As a Lead DevOps Engineer , you’ll own and evolve cloud infrastructure that powers AI‑driven products, ensuring scalability, reliability, and security across distributed systems. You’ll lead modernization efforts in AWS, streamline CI/CD pipelines, and champion automation and observability best practices. This role combines hands‑on technical leadership with strategic impact, offering the opportunity to shape infrastructure standards and drive innovation in a fast‑paced, collaborative environment.

WHAT YOU WILL DO
  • Lead cross‑cutting infrastructure projects not tied to app/platform changes, such as domain migrations for pipelines and customer‑facing sites, networking redesigns to avoid IP exhaustion, and medium‑sized automation initiatives.
  • Design and evolve AWS networking and environments to support more dev/test sites, future SaaS infrastructure, and sandboxes where dev teams can experiment safely.
  • Define and implement a disaster recovery strategy and secondary region or DR zone to improve resilience and recovery time.
  • Implement cost, reliability, observability, and monitoring improvements across services, using metrics and logs to guide optimization.
  • Design, maintain, and evolve AWS‑based infrastructure, including ECS, RDS/Aurora, Lambda, S3, CloudWatch, CDK, VPCs, subnets, security groups, Route 53, and load balancers.
  • Upgrade AWS Aurora Postgres clusters to the latest supported versions, ensuring high availability, data integrity, and minimal downtime.
  • Own and improve CI/CD pipelines using GitHub Actions for production deployments, covering containerized services and Lambda‑based workloads.
  • Manage infrastructure as code using AWS CDK (TypeScript) and other IaC practices to drive automation, consistency, and repeatability.
  • Consolidate and optimize shared tooling, utility scripts, and reusable components across multiple repositories.
  • Collaborate with engineering and leadership to define the infrastructure roadmap, influence architecture decisions, and promote DevOps culture and best practices.
MUST HAVES
  • 6+ years of experience in DevOps / Site Reliability Engineering, including ownership of multi‑quarter infrastructure projects or leadership roles.
  • Strong expertise with AWS services such as ECS, RDS/Aurora, Lambda, S3, CloudWatch, CDK, and core networking (VPC design, routing, subnets, security groups, NAT, DNS/Route 53, load balancers).
  • Proficient with Docker, GitHub Actions, and modern CI/CD patterns for cloud‑native applications.
  • Deep knowledge of Postgres administration, including upgrades, backups, and performance tuning.
  • Strong scripting and automation skills with TypeScript, Python, or Bash.
  • Proven ability to architect scalable, secure, and reliable cloud environments, including DR strategies and cost‑optimization practices.
  • Experience improving observability (metrics, logs, traces, alerting) and using it to guide reliability and cost improvements.
  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with a track record of working closely with engineers and stakeholders to execute infra roadmaps.
  • Self‑driven, practical, and detail‑oriented, comfortable making decisions, documenting trade‑offs, and delivering high‑quality results with limited supervision.
  • Upper‑intermediate English level.
NICE TO HAVES
  • Familiarity with AI/ML workflows or cloud‑based AI services.
  • Experience with AWS Bedrock or similar generative AI platforms.
  • Exposure to Cursor or other modern AI‑enhanced developer tools.
  • Understanding of security and scaling best practices for distributed environments.
  • Experience with monitoring and observability tools (Datadog, Prometheus, CloudWatch, etc.).
PERKS AND BENEFITS
  • Professional growth: Accelerate your professional journey with mentorship, TechTalks, and personalized growth roadmaps.
  • Competitive compensation: We match your ever‑growing skills, talent, and contributions with competitive USD‑based compensation and budgets for education, fitness, and team activities.
  • A selection of exciting projects: Join projects with modern solutions development and top‑tier clients that include Fortune 500 enterprises and leading product brands.
  • Flextime: Tailor your schedule for an optimal work‑life balance, with options of working from home or coming to the office – whatever makes you the happiest and most productive.

title: People Development Partner
description:
Join to apply for the People Development Partner role at Jellyfish .

Jellyfish is a full‑service global digital agency that merges strategy, creative, data, media buying and planning with technology under one integrated roof. With nearly 2,000 employees across 38 offices worldwide, we are the unconventional global marketing partner of the future.

We understand both brand and activation, ensuring clients reach, influence and connect with the right audiences. We deliver culturally relevant creativity that cuts through clutter and sets hearts (and feeds) on fire.

As part of the Brandtech Group we’re at the forefront of deploying GenAI tools. In PencilPro we host the world’s number‑one generative‑AI platform, revolutionising creative production, distribution and performance prediction.

About the Role

This People Development Partner will architect and deliver enterprise‑wide learning programs for our global workforce. You’ll focus on high‑impact programs that require consistency, quality and broad reach—leadership development, onboarding, emerging capabilities and core skills training forming the foundation of our learning ecosystem.

Reporting to the Senior People Development Partner, this role requires systems thinking, program design excellence and coordination with regional colleagues to localise programs. You’ll balance centralised design with distributed delivery, ensuring quality and regional relevance.

What You’ll Do Design & Deliver Global Leadership Development
  • Design and deliver comprehensive leadership development programs for managers worldwide.
  • Create blended learning experiences with e‑learning modules, virtual workshops, coaching and peer learning.
  • Develop core leadership curriculum covering essential management and leadership capabilities.
  • Build facilitator guides and enable regional colleagues to deliver local cohorts with consistency.
  • Leverage assessment tools to personalise leadership development and build self‑awareness.
  • Measure program impact, including behaviour change and leadership effectiveness.
  • Design a resource library of leadership tools, toolkits, templates and curated content.
Own Global Onboarding & Early Careers
  • Design and continuously improve the enterprise onboarding experience for all new hires.
  • Create role‑specific onboarding pathways for different functions and organisational levels.
  • Build onboarding e‑learning covering culture, tools, processes and compliance.
  • Coordinate with regional partners and hiring managers for consistent delivery.
  • Design early‑careers programs with clear learning pathways and development milestones.
  • Track onboarding effectiveness through feedback mechanisms and productivity metrics.
Drive Emerging Capability Development
  • Design and deliver training on emerging capabilities such as AI, digital fluency and future‑focused skills.
  • Build e‑learning curriculum on new tools and technologies relevant to various roles.
  • Partner with subject‑matter experts to identify capability priorities and training needs.
  • Facilitate hands‑on workshops providing practical application and problem‑solving.
  • Launch and support new learning tools and technologies.
  • Track capability adoption and growth through data and skills assessments.
Build Core Skills & E‑Learning Library
  • Design enterprise‑wide skills workshops on communication, productivity and professional development.
  • Build a comprehensive e‑learning library organised by role, level and skill domain.
  • Curate external content into guided learning pathways.
  • Coordinate with regional colleagues on delivery and provide facilitator guides and quality assurance.
  • Partner with subject‑matter experts to build technical and functional content.
  • Establish content governance, including review cycles, version control and lifecycle management.
Essential
  • 5-7 years in Learning & Development roles with strong program design and facilitation experience.
  • Proven track record designing and delivering large‑scale learning programs.
  • Instructional‑design expertise creating engaging, outcome‑focused learning experiences across modalities.
  • Facilitation experience with global audiences via virtual delivery.
  • E‑learning development portfolio using authoring tools.
  • Experience with leadership development programs and manager training.
  • Project‑management skills managing multiple concurrent programmes with competing deadlines.
  • Coordination skills working across matrix organisations and partnering with regional colleagues.
Desired
  • Coaching certification or experience coaching managers.
  • Experience with emerging‑technology training including AI and digital transformation.
  • Train‑the‑trainer certification or experience enabling others to facilitate.
  • Background in digital, technology or professional services industries.
  • Degree in Learning & Development, Instructional Design or related field.
Technical Capabilities
  • Instructional design methodologies and assessment design.
  • E‑learning authoring tools (Articulate Rise/Storyline, Camtasia, Adobe Captivate).
  • LMS administration and content publishing.
  • Virtual facilitation platforms and collaboration tools.
  • Video editing and multimedia content creation.
  • Learning evaluation and measurement frameworks.
Personal Attributes
  • Systems thinker who designs programmes that interconnect and see the big picture.
  • Scalability mindset, building solutions for large populations using train‑the‑trainer approaches.
  • Collaborative spirit, partnering effectively and sharing ownership generously.
  • Programme‑management capability, juggling multiple complex initiatives and delivering with quality.
  • Innovation orientation, exploring new technologies, methodologies and delivery approaches.
  • Quality obsession, maintaining high standards and representing the function with excellence.
  • Learning agility, mastering new content domains quickly and staying current on trends.
Jellyfish Values
  • We Are Real & Rigorous – cutting through noise with real analysis and brilliant rigour.
  • We Are Free‑Thinking – creating, inventing, staying curious and always challenging convention.
  • We Are All Authors – taking ownership, supporting one another and leading by example.
  • We Are One Bloom – diverse skill sets, radically collaborating for shared success.
Behaviours
  • Client‑Centric Mindset – anticipates client needs and proactively provides solutions or recommendations.
  • Ownership and Accountability – owns mistakes, identifies lessons learned and implements improvements to avoid repetition.
  • Problem‑Solving – identifies potential obstacles early and develops actionable solutions to mitigate risks.
  • Commitment to Growth and Learning – proactively seeks feedback from colleagues and clients to identify areas for improvement.
Seniority level
  • Mid‑Senior level
Employment type
  • Full‑time
Job function
  • Business Development and Sales
  • Advertising Services

Com experiência em gestão de negócios, desde 1955, a WLM atua no segmento automotivo e no agronegócio.

title: Senior Product Manager - Performance RE São Paulo - SP and Hybrid Full-time employee
description:
Job description

Somos uma empresa 100% digital, com tecnologia desenvolvida localmente e líder no mercado de compra e venda online. Nos tornamos a marca que melhor representa a economia circular no país.

Hoje contamos com dois escritórios nas cidades de Rio de Janeiro e São Paulo. Nosso modelo de trabalho flexível oferece autonomia e liberdade para que nossas pessoas elaborem seus padrões e rotinas com disciplina e protagonismo na conexão com negócio, as prioridades e o propósito da empresa.

Construir um ambiente diverso, inclusivo e comprometido com a equidade faz parte do nosso DNA. Entendemos que diversidade, equidade e inclusão são essenciais para criarmos um ambiente seguro com entregas inovadoras e eficientes para nossas pessoas e sociedade.

Main responsibilities

Se você gosta de aprender e quer fazer parte desse desafio, essa oportunidade é a sua chance. Nessa posição de Senior Product Manager , você vai somar ao time Real Estate que tem como objetivo prover inteligência de mercado, visibilidade de dados, qualificação e visão de performance para tomada de decisão dos anunciantes em nossa plataforma, bem como suas alavancas de engajamento.

No dia a dia você vai:

  • Definir e evoluir a estratégia de Qualificação e Performance, alinhada aos objetivos de crescimento da empresa e às necessidades dos usuários;
  • Identificar e priorizar, visando otimizar a performance e a personalização dos resultados apresentados aos anunciantes;
  • Trabalhar de perto com equipes de Engenharia, Dados, Design, Comercial e Marketing para garantir uma experiência fluida e eficiente;
  • Testar, iterar e implementar novas funcionalidades, aprimorando constantemente a experiência na plataforma;
  • Acompanhar e analisar métricas-chave de negócio e experiência (como engajamento, ROI, funil completo de conversão, impressão, taxa de cliques, tempo de permanência, leads) para medir o impacto das melhorias realizadas e garantir a otimização contínua;
  • Liderar uma squad multidisciplinar de alta performance (designers, engenheiros, analistas de dados, entre outros) para garantir a entrega de valor e o alinhamento das iniciativas com os objetivos estratégicos;
  • Fomentar uma cultura de experimentação, conduzindo testes A/B, pesquisas de satisfação de usuários e análises quantitativas/qualitativas para validar hipóteses e melhorias;
  • Acompanhar as tendências de mercado e concorrência para trazer insights valiosos e boas práticas para o aprimoramento.
Requirements and skills

E o que você precisa ter?

  • Experiência como Product Manager em produtos digitais;
  • Habilidade em definir estratégias baseadas em dados e priorizar iniciativas com impacto mensurável, focando na experiência do usuário e no desempenho do produto;
  • Experiência com metodologias ágeis (Scrum, Kanban, Lean) e gestão de squads multidisciplinares;
  • Capacidade analítica avançada para identificar oportunidades e tomar decisões estratégicas baseadas em dados;

title: Medical Science Liaison
description:
Medical Science Liaison

  • Location: Rio de Janeiro / Belo Horizonte
  • Field-based work model

At Sanofi, we are driven by one purpose – we chase the miracles of science to improve people's lives. Our team, across some 100 countries, is dedicated to transforming the practice of medicine by working to turn the impossible into the possible.

We never settle and now we are creating a new paradigm with a first-in-class therapy in Autoimmune Diabetes (Type 1 Diabetes).

Our newest core asset, resulting from the acquisition of Prevention Bio in General Medicines Autoimmune Type 1 Diabetes space, aims at delaying the onset of stage 3 type 1 diabetes. This means that for the first time, people at risk of developing this lifelong disease have fresh hope. What delayed onset means is more time for children to be children with less healthcare and more care-free childhood. The delay also gives families and healthcare professionals more time to prepare care plans for a later diagnosis.

Job Description

We are seeking a highly motivated and visionary scientific leader to serve as a MSL with expertise in T1D. This role combines deep scientific expertise with strategic thinking to enhance the identification and management of people at risk of developing T1D, emphasizing the benefits of early detection and the use of new immunomodulators.

As a MSL - Autoimmune T1D Specialist, you will be the trusted scientific partner for external experts and decision-makers, while also contributing to the development and implementation of screening and monitoring strategies as well as engaging with experts in new therapies such as immunomodulators. This dual focus position will drive both scientific exchange and strategic initiatives to improve early identification and management of T1D.

Main responsibilities Scientific Leadership & KOL Engagement
  • Serve as trusted scientific partner to key external experts (including KOLs, endocrinologists, pediatricians, and other scientific stakeholders), establishing and maintaining robust, long-term peer relationships
  • Conduct high-touch scientific exchange with experts from Centers of Excellence and beyond to convey a compelling and highly scientific narrative on T1D disease stages, importance of screening and treatment
  • Engage with experts to share scientific data, answer product-specific questions, and support them in developing best practices (e.g., infusion protocols)
  • Link internal partners to external thought leaders for education and research collaboration
  • Disseminate innovative medical education materials and foster medical/scientific information exchange within the medical community
  • Tailor engagement to different stakeholder segments based on comprehensive stakeholder mapping and local go-to-market model
  • Work with cross-functional teams to leverage an omnichannel approach, orchestrating high-touch and personalized engagement across innovative channels (e.g., social media, peer-to-peer communities, online portals)
Early Detection Strategy
  • Collaborate with medical teams to develop and implement evidence-based screening and monitoring protocols
  • Provide scientific expertise in the development of risk-identification strategies
  • Support the adaptation of global screening and monitoring strategies to local contexts
  • Contribute to the scientific validation of new testing methodologies and channels
  • Engage with experts to promote best practices in screening and early intervention
  • Promote experience sharing among key external experts to reinforce consensus on screening and treatment protocols at local level
Strategic Implementation
  • Partner with cross-functional teams in agile settings with self-organized teams around main customer accounts to improve patient pathways and remove barriers
  • Provide scientific input on screening partnerships and initiatives
  • Gather and analyze field insights to inform medical strategy and screening programs
  • Support Market Access teams in evidence-based discussions with regional payers, drug formulary committees, and key account decision-makers on clinical value and health economics
  • Coordinate and direct requests for ISS, RCT, Managed Access Programs to appropriate teams
  • Keep up-to-date on medical and scientific developments in the Type 1 Diabetes field
Individual Contributors
  • Maintain knowledge of and comply with the principles of Ethics and Integrity, Sanofi policies, and codes of conduct that regulate the pharmaceutical market.
  • Comply with and promote Sanofi's Health, Safety, and Environment (HSE) policies, with the objective of preventing accidents, avoiding health risks, promoting employee well-being, and reducing environmental impacts resulting from work activities.
  • Support Sanofi's Diversity and Inclusion strategy and initiatives to ensure that all employees and partners are treated with respect and receive equal opportunities.
About you Experience
  • Minimum 3 years experience as MSL in Specialty / Rare disease / Type 1 Diabetes area
  • Experience in T1D or immunology highly preferred
  • Background in clinical research or academic setting
  • Experience with population health initiatives or screening programs is a plus
Soft skills
  • Strategic thinking.
  • Business acumen.
  • Interpersonal relationship.
  • Transversal collaboration.
  • Learning agility.
  • Ability to build proper environment to enable Playing to Win culture to flourish.
Professional competencies
  • Strong analytical capabilities for data interpretation and insights generation
  • Excellence in scientific communication and presentation
  • Strategic thinking and ability to translate science into actionable insights
  • Strong collaboration skills for cross-functional teamwork
  • Ability to build and maintain relationships with key stakeholders
  • Project management capabilities
Technical skills
  • Advanced understanding of T1D clinical science and current research
  • Expertise in interpreting and communicating complex scientific data
  • Knowledge of screening methodologies and monitoring protocols
  • Understanding of healthcare systems and population health approaches
Education
  • Advanced degree required (MD, PharmD, PhD) in relevant scientific or medical field
  • Additional training in public health or population health management preferred
Language

Advanced English required.

Why should you choose us?
  • Be part of a purpose-driven organization that pursues the miracles of science to improve people's lives worldwide
  • Access comprehensive benefits including health insurance, life insurance, and pension plans aligned with market best practices
  • Enjoy flexible work arrangements that support work-life integration and well-being
  • Benefit from continuous learning and development opportunities through Sanofi University and specialized training programs
  • Be part of building a new concept in autoimmune Type 1 Diabetes by bringing early detection and the use of new immunomodulators capable of changing the course of the disease.
  • Join Brazil's largest and fastest-growing immunology franchise, playing a key role in the growth strategy and market leadership

title: MSF Access Executive Director
description:
Location: Strong preference to be based in one of the five MSF Access Regional Hubs (Rio de Janeiro, Dakar, Brussels, Nairobi, and Kuala Lumpur). Placement in associated strategic locations may be considered.

Duration: MSF office contract, minimum 3 years commitment, extendable by 3 years, according to MSF practice and subject to national labour laws

Deadline to Apply:

Compensation and benefits: MSF practice is to offer the C&B package current in the MSF entity establishing the contract.

Reporting to: The MSF Access Executive Board

Start date: Beginning of Q2 2026 preferred with some flexibility depending on individual circumstances

MSF INTERNATIONAL

Médecins Sans Frontières (MSF) is an international, independent, medical humanitarian organisation that delivers emergency aid to people affected by armed conflict, epidemics, healthcare exclusion and natural disasters. MSF offers assistance to people based only on need and irrespective of race, religion, gender or political affiliation. MSF International is the legal entity that binds MSF’s 24 sections, 28 associations and other offices together. Based in Geneva, MSF International provides coordination, information and support to the MSF movement, and implements international projects and initiatives as requested. MSF is committed to an inclusive culture that encourages and supports the diverse voices of our employees. We welcome applications from individuals of all genders, ages, sexual orientations, nationalities, races, religions, beliefs, ability status, and all other diversity characteristics.

POSITION BACKGROUND

Ensuring access to key medical tools is critical to MSF's Social Mission. MSF has been engaged in a wide variety of ways to improve the access situation over the past decades through the vehicle of the Access Campaign. In 2023, MSF’s International General Assembly unanimously voted a Vision that is anchoring addressing Access to Products Healthcare as being integral to its Social Mission:

“Over the coming decade, MSF will pursue and accentuate its activities aimed at delivering tangible improvements in Access to Products for Healthcare for people who are deprived of them. Whilst our actions will be as specific to operational contexts as possible, they will also be as global as necessary to achieve the specific improvements sought. This work will expose and address problems faced by patients and by operational teams, will involve the mobilization of the entire movement towards common ambitions, and will leverage the potential of partnerships. It will also preserve space for innovation and reflect the multiple expressions of our social mission. These activities will be in-depth, diverse in nature and adequately resourced, and we will learn from their successes and failures. These ambitions will be reflected in how we structure and govern this work.”

Médecins Sans Frontières works tirelessly to improve the accessibility, availability, affordability, appropriateness and quality of products for health care for the populations it assists and their communities. While this is a collective effort across the organisation, the MSF Access team plays a central role as it identifies and implements a priority selection of access projects, offers expert support for access activities elsewhere in MSF, and brings together information and analysis relevant to MSF’s access work. The MSF Access team, overseen by an Executive Board, is based around five regional hubs: Kuala Lumpur, Nairobi, Brussels, Dakar and Rio de Janeiro.

PLACE IN THE ORGANISATION

The Executive Director (ED) will be accountable to the MSF Access Executive Board for the proper oversight and management of the MSF Access resources and the execution of MSF Access’s mandate.

PURPOSE OF THE POSITION

The ED is responsible for the overall strategic, institutional, and representational leadership of MSF Access. The focus of the ED’s role will be on shepherding the vision, strategy, management, external engagement of MSF Access. Working closely with the Deputy Executive Director (DED), the ED focuses on strategic direction, high-level external representation and engagement, and internal governance and institutional management while the DED ensures medical relevance, rigour and operational grounding.

PRIMARY RESPONSIBILITIES

The Executive Director’s primary responsibilities will include:

Strategic Leadership, Governance and Accountability

  • Implementation of the strategy vision of MSF Access

  • Leading development, implementation, monitoring and periodic revision of the MSF Access Strategic Plan by means of the annual/multi-year plan and budget

  • Executive leadership of the MSF Access team, including management of the MSF Access management team alongside the Deputy Executive Director

  • Final responsibility for, ongoing engagement with and reporting on the strategic progress, performance, annual budgets and expenditures, and risk mitigation strategies of MSF Access to the Executive Board, and when necessary, other MSF leadership and decision-making platforms such as the Full Executive Committee

  • Promoting processes for reflection, learning and continuous improvement across MSF Access

External Representation and Engagement

  • Representation of MSF Access in critical high-level global health and access discussions including in multilateral fora and processes, in government engagements where requested, with private sector leaders and other relevant stakeholders alongside the MSF Access MT

  • Steer MSF Access’s overall external partnership strategy in alignment with the broader MSF Access strategy and cultivate engagement with key global health and access stakeholders

Internal Leadership and Management

  • Management and coordination of key MSF Access functions (as articulated below) alongside the management team

  • Report to the MSF Access Board on key strategic and governance decisions and with informational updates of note, including but not limited to, major decisions relating to the content of MSF’s Access work, any material engagement with MSF leadership and governance structures, management of the MSF Access MT along with the DED, regular budgetary updates and accountabilities, and alongside the Head of Human Resources any HR issues requiring the attention of the board.

  • Alongside the DED and management team, translating the MSF Access Strategic Plan into annual plans for each respective body of work, including through individual projects and initiatives

  • Oversee development of MSF Access administrative policies and processes and addressing critical human resources issues

  • Development and finalization of the MSF Access annual plan and budget alongside relevant members of the management team

  • Representing MSF Access on the Medical Operational (MedOps) platform (which includes all medical directors and directors of operations across MSF) including participation in MedOps meetings as required

The ED is also responsible for ensuring that MSF Access fulfils its articulated responsibilities to the movement, which are:

  • Advise the Movement on the Common Priorities

  • Provide or source support on access issues to all entities that request it within MSF

  • Design and implement access initiatives to respond to the Common Priorities

  • Maintain an overview and report on access initiatives movement-wide on an annual basis

  • Survey and analyze the external access landscape

QUALIFICATIONS

  • 15+ years of senior management and leadership experience in global health policy, advocacy, institutional management, or humanitarian affairs

  • PhD or Master’s degree in health sciences (medical, (bio)medical, pharmacy) or international relations, public policy, public administration, public health with significant experience working in and knowledge of global health and access issues.

  • Demonstrated experience in global health and access issues in a broad range of subjects relevant to MSF’s medical humanitarian mission and operations.

  • Deep understanding of MSF’s operational and medical nature and its medical humanitarian mission.

  • Advanced managerial capabilities and experience with excellent project management capabilities, multidisciplinary teams and ability to work effectively and independently in a fast-paced environment.

  • Experience in developing and maintaining professional relationships with a wide range of stakeholders and organizations, including government officials, multilateral representatives, medical professionals, civil society, community organizations, academia, and global health donor organizations.

  • Experience in strategy development processes and demonstrated strategic thinking capabilities.

  • Proven track record of external engagements and external representation; ability to actively participate in public speaking engagements, including—but not limited to—presenting at conferences, conducting print and broadcast media interviews, and representation in external meetings.

Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted.

At MSF, we are committed to an inclusive culture that encourages and supports the diverse voices of our employees. We welcome applications from individuals of all genders, ages, sexual orientations, nationalities, races, religions, beliefs, ability status, and all other diversity characteristics.

MSF is committed to preventing abuse, inappropriate behaviour, lack of integrity and financial misconduct in its work and care spaces. MSF expects all staff to share this commitment and promote an environment where abuse and misconduct is not tolerated.

We are committed to removing barriers for people with specific accessibility needs. If you need an adjustment to the recruitment process to be considered for the role, please let us know from the beginning of the selection process.

Se você quer transformar a energia, estamos procurando um Especialista Soluções Digitais para se juntar à nossa equipe de Network Delivery Rio.

Com quem você trabalhará

Você se juntará à equipe de Network Delivery Rio, área de telecomunicações responsável por garantir a disponibilidade, estabilidade, segurança e alta performance de todas as redes e serviços de telecomunicações, sendo a principal responsável por toda a infraestrutura de dados e voz.

O que você fará Responsabilidades

    • Gerenciar a infraestrutura de rede (LAN/WAN), incluindo roteadores, switches, firewalls e balanceadores de carga;

A ENEL é uma empresa multicultural que valoriza a diversidade e a inclusão em todas as suas formas. Esta vaga é aberta para talentos de todas as idades, origens étnicas, gêneros, orientações sexuais, identidades de gênero e pessoas com ou sem deficiência. Na ENEL acreditamos que a verdadeira inovação surge da diversidade! Nosso processo de seleção é personalizado para cada função e inclui uma entrevista com nossos recrutadores e uma reunião com o gestor para uma avaliação técnica. Se você estiver alinhado com a descrição do cargo, a equipe de recrutamento entrará em contato com você, fornecendo informações adicionais sobre o processo de recrutamento. Estamos procurando pessoas que incorporem nossos valores: Confiança, Respeito, Inovação, Proatividade e Flexibilidade. Você está pronto para fazer a diferença e crescer conosco? Inscreva-se agora e junte-se a nós na liderança da transição energética dentro da equipe de Network Delivery Rio.

Somos líderes globais em geração, distribuição e vendas de energia, bem como a maior operadora privada de energia renovável. Geramos, entregamos e vendemos energia em 28 países na Europa, Américas, África, Ásia e Oceania e somos comprometidos com o desenvolvimento de comunidades locais e clientes. Main responsibilities

Se você é uma pessoa organizada , com visão estratégica e que se motiva por transformação , essa é a sua oportunidade. Nesta posição de Especialista PMO , você terá o papel central de garantir a execução e o sucesso dos projetos mais importantes e transformadores da companhia, sendo a ponte entre a operação e o C-level. Seu trabalho será essencial para traduzir a estratégia em ação e resultados concretos.

No dia a dia você vai:

Requirements and skills

  • Conhecimento em Metodologias de Projetos: Profundo conhecimento e experiência prática em metodologias de gestão de projetos (e.g., PMBOK, PRINCE2, Agile/Scrum, OKR).
  • Análise de Dados e KPIs: Habilidade avançada em análise de dados, métricas de projeto (e.g., Earned Value, Burn Rate) e elaboração de dashboards e relatórios executivos.
  • Ensino Superior Completo: Preferencialmente em Administração, Engenharia, Economia ou áreas correlatas. Pós-graduação será um diferencial.

Será considerado como um diferencial:

No Brasil desde 2010, o Grupo OLX tem como propósito empoderar as pessoas para que alcancem seus sonhos, reinventando o modelo de consumo. Com a aquisição do Grupo ZAP, concluída em outubro de 2020, a companhia opera a OLX, plataforma horizontal com posição de liderança nas categorias de automóveis, bens de consumo usados e imóveis; e duas plataformas líderes do mercado imobiliário, ZAP e Viva Real.
